title: Account Standing on Northgate Card Accounts — Suspension, Charge-Off, Closure and Security Deposit Refund
content:
**Days past due.** Days past due on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account are the calendar days from the payment due date of the oldest statement whose minimum payment remains unmet, to the date being evaluated; they are 0 when every minimum payment due has been met.

**Suspension and restoration.** Charging privileges are suspended when the days past due reach the card's suspension threshold, or at once while a fraud review is open, and are restored when every past-due minimum payment has been met or the fraud review clears.

**Charge-off.** A suspended account is charged off when the days past due reach the card's charge-off threshold.

**Closure.** Closing the account is the cardholder's own decision: the agent records the request on the account and the cardholder confirms it. An account can be closed at the cardholder's request only while it is in active status, as the system record of the card account shows it. A closed account takes no new charges, but the remaining balance continues to be repaid on the existing terms, open disputes continue to their resolution and special financing periods continue to run.

**Security deposit refund.** On a Northgate Secured Card the security deposit is refunded within the card's deposit refund business days after the account is closed with a zero balance, or after graduation; where a balance remains at closure the deposit is first applied to it and only the remainder is refunded.

| Account status at the cardholder's closing request | Can be closed at the cardholder's request |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| suspended, closed, charged off, applied or declined | no |

Hypothetical deposit illustration: a Northgate Secured Card with a 300.00 deposit closed with a remaining balance of 45.00 applies 45.00 of the deposit to the balance and refunds the remaining 255.00; closed with a zero balance, it refunds the whole 300.00.
